reviewed_contract: Fixed immutable three-name plan, source/archive roots and owned quarantine/pointer/receipt names; new retirement state only. ANCHOR and protected restart/replay/link targets are outside allowlist.
All17 evidence/config/queue/helper/source-manifest/verified-receipt pins passed through independently executed real plan-only mode; no source/archive payloads read.

Archive-driver name/stat/sha256 schema adapted explicitly; exact old stat fields, complete membership, regular file nlink1, root-relative safe paths, counts and logical sizes checked. Private frozen helper instance preserves original helper file and sets current source/quarantine/STOP identities correctly.

Execution freshly hashes complete external archive and every selected source file at16MiB/s, compares pinned hashes, and repeats source inventory and archive/mount stability checks. External archive must be a single regular file on a different filesystem with unchanged verified size/mtime.

Host boot/PID1 and exact known inaccessible process identities retained; new unreadable live processes rejected. cwd/fd/maps/cmdline, shallow aliases and nested source mounts checked before and after quarantine; visible limits remain explicit.
Quarantine rename tolerates only root ctime change. Original source must remain absent; final external mount/archive identity and fd-safe rmtree checks precede removal. Archive is never deleted.

Exclusive done/failure receipts and restore pointer preserve evidence. Pre-removal failure retains source or full quarantine; rmtree failure may leave partial quarantine and earlier completed pools remain completed. No automatic retry.

Final pointer status becomes COMPLETE only after valid completion receipt. Existing pointer content/metadata checked, exclusive fsynced temporary written, atomic replace plus parent-directory fsync; last-stage failures preserve completion evidence and report finalize_restore_pointer.

Pinned running archive driver iterates its fixed plan forward and does not revisit completed pools or auto-adopt existing attempts. APF excluded from remaining queue; historical completed f_only/iter118 entries do not introduce new current work. No running driver/plan changes made.

pointer_cases.scope: Reviewed author harness executed independently for these two cases only, with genuine temporary filesystem/hash/rename/deletion and explicit mount/device/process substitutes.

author_validation_inspected_not_fully_re.scope: Success, bad archive/source hashes, hardlink/symlink, mutation during hashing, post-quarantine consumer, final mount loss, partial rmtree failure and final-pointer replacement failure.

limitations: This is prelaunch qualification of exact script/plan, not evidence real cleanup or payload verification has executed. Parent owns launch with required nice19/CPU0,1.
Known inaccessible process identities and future or deeper aliases/consumers are not certified absent; current host dependencies are refreshed by execution.
Archive ACL/xattrs capture is not independently verified. After retirement external archive is the surviving copy; no future drive-availability guarantee.

STOP is checked before removal and during hashing; interruption of rmtree can leave partial quarantine. Post-removal pointer failure can leave done plus failed receipts and requires stage-aware inspection.
Concurrent archive/generation jobs affect measured free-space change. No full replay-tree or large archive read was performed during this review.
not_performed: Production checkpoint/source or archive payload hashing
